name: au-land-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Australian state or territory land tax. Trigger on phrases like "land tax", "unimproved value", "site value", "land tax threshold", "principal place of residence exemption", "foreign owner surcharge", "absentee owner surcharge", "land tax objection", "Valuer-General", "surcharge land tax", "land tax deductible", or any question about annual state taxes on land ownership in NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, ACT, or NT. Covers the nature of land tax, aggregation, thresholds and rates by state, surcharges, trusts, companies, exemptions, objections, GL treatment, and deductibility. ALWAYS read this skill before advising on Australian land tax.
